fragments.text: Hello, Junior Cycle camp, Jake speaking.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 你好，少年自行车训练营，我是杰克。

fragments.text: Hi. I'm calling for some
about the cycle camp - I'm thinking of
my son.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 嗨。我打电话是想了解一些关于自行车夏令营的信息——我在考虑送我的儿子去。

fragments.text: Great. Well, it's held every weekday morning over the
and we focus on

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 太好了。嗯，这个活动在暑假的每个工作日早上举行，我们注重基本的骑行技巧和安全。

fragments.text: We have
for children from
years upwards.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 我们对三岁以上的孩子有八个级别。

fragments.text: How old's your son?

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 你儿子多大了？

fragments.text: Charlie? He's seven.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 查理？他七岁了。

fragments.text: He can ride a bike, but he needs a little more
before he's safe to go on the road.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 他会骑自行车，但在他安全上路之前，他还需要多一点训练。

fragments.text: He'd probably be best in Level 5.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 他可能是第五级最好的。

fragments.text: They start off practising on the site here, and we aim to get them riding on the road, but first they're taken to ride in the
, away from the traffic.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 他们开始在这里的场地练习，我们的目的是让他们骑在路上，但首先他们被带到公园里骑，远离交通。

fragments.text: Right. And can you tell me a bit about the

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 对。你能告诉我一些关于教官的情况吗？

fragments.text: Well, all our staff wear different coloured

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 嗯，我们所有的员工都穿不同颜色的衬衫。

fragments.text: So, we have
and they have red shirts.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 所以，我们有三个主管，他们穿着红色的衬衫。

fragments.text: They support the instructors, and they also
for me if I'm not around.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 他们支持(协助）教官，如果我不在身边，他们也会代替我。

fragments.text: Then the instructors themselves are in blue shirts, and one of these is
each class.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 然后教官自己穿着蓝色衬衫，每节课都有一名负责。

fragments.text: OK.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: In order to be accepted, all our instructors have to
from someone who's seen them work with children - like if they've worked as a
, for example.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 为了被接受，我们所有的老师都必须提交一份看过他们和孩子一起工作的人的推荐信，比如他们做过保姆。

fragments.text: Then they have to complete our training course, including how to do
, and generally care for the well-being of the kids in their class.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 然后他们必须完成我们的培训课程，包括如何做教案，并普遍关心他们班孩子的福祉。

fragments.text: They do a great job, I have to say.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 我不得不说，他们做得很好。

fragments.text: Right. And tell me a bit about the classes.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 对。告诉我一些关于课程的情况。

fragments.text: What size will Charlie's class be?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 查理的班级规模将有多大？

fragments.text: We have a
of eight children in each class, so their instructor really gets to know them well.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 我们每个班最多有八个孩子，所以他们的老师真的很了解他们。

fragments.text: They're out riding most of the time but they have quiet times too, where their instructor might tell them a
that's got something to do with cycling, or get them to play a
together.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 他们大部分时间都在外面骑车，但也有不动的时候，他们的教练可能会给他们讲一个与骑车有关的故事，或者让他们一起玩一个游戏。

fragments.text: It's a lot of fun.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 这很有趣。

fragments.text: It must be. Now, what happens if there's

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 一定是。现在，如果碰巧下雨了怎么办？

fragments.text: Do the classes still

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 仍然要上课吗？

fragments.text: Oh yes. We don't let that put us off - we just put on our
and keep

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 哦，是的。我们不会因此而推迟——我们只是穿上防水衣，继续骑自行车。

fragments.text: And is there anything special Charlie should bring along with him?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 查理应该随身带什么特别的东西吗？

fragments.text: Well, maybe some spare clothes, especially if the weather's not so good.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 嗯，可能会有一些备用衣服，尤其是天气不太好的时候。

fragments.text: And a
for

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 和课间休息时（食用）的零食。

fragments.text: How about a drink?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 饮料需要带吗？

fragments.text: No, we'll
that.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 不，我们会提供的。

fragments.text: And make sure he has
shoes, not sandals.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 还要确保他有鞋子，而不是凉鞋。

fragments.text: Sure. And just at present Charlie has to
every few hours, so I'll make sure he has that.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 当然。目前查理每隔几个小时就要服用药物，所以，我要确定他能有（服用药物的）那个条件。

fragments.text: Absolutely. Just give us
of when he has to take it and we'll make sure he does.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 当然。只要告诉我们他什么时候必须服用，我们会确保他服用。

fragments.text: Thanks.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 谢谢。

fragments.text: Now, there are a few things you should know about Day 1 of the camp.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 关于营地的第一天，有几件事你应该知道。

fragments.text: The classes normally start at 9.30 every morning, but on Day 1 you should aim to get Charlie here by 9.20.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 通常每天早上9:30开始上课，但第一天你应该争取在9:20之前把查理送到这里。

fragments.text: The
will be 12.30 as usual.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 结束时间照例是在 12:30。

fragments.text: We need the
because there are a few
to do.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 我们需要额外的时间，因为还有一些额外的事情要做。

fragments.text: The most important is that we have a very careful
to make sure that every child's
fits properly.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 最重要的是我们有一个非常仔细的检查，以确保每个孩子的头盔都合适。

fragments.text: If it doesn't fit, we'll try to
it, or we'll find him another one - but he must wear it all the time he's on the bike.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 如果不合身，我们会试着调整一下，或者再给他找一件——但他骑自行车的时候必须一直穿着。

fragments.text: Of course.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 当然。

fragments.text: Then after that, all the instructors will be waiting to meet their classes, and they'll meet up in the
- you can't miss it.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 之后，所有的老师都会等着去上课，他们会在帐篷里见面——你不会错过的。

fragments.text: And each instructor will take their class away and get started.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 每位老师将会带走他们的班级并开始（上课）。

fragments.text: OK. Well that all sounds good.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 嗯，好嘞，听起来都不错。

fragments.text: Now can you tell me how much the camp
a week?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 现在你能告诉我营地一周多少钱吗？

fragments.text: We've managed to keep the price more or less the same as last year - it was
then. But the places are filling up quite quickly.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.translation: 我们设法使价格和去年差不多——那时是一百九十美元。但名额很快就满了。

fragments.text: Right. OK, well I'd like to
for ...

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 对。好的，我想预订……
